第 136 章 神农女禁术枯木逢春（第1页）
绿色的光芒如同春日暖阳，温柔地笼罩住每一个重伤倒地的人。神农女张开双臂，周身百草灵力疯狂翻涌，原本微弱的绿光此刻变得璀璨夺目，将昏暗的战场照得一片通明。
她的身体在微微颤抖，每一寸肌肤都在燃烧。神农血脉在她的体内沸腾，化作源源不断的生命之力，注入到众人的身体里。
悟空胸口那道深可见骨的血洞，以肉眼可见的速度愈合着。金色的血液停止了流淌，断裂的肋骨重新拼接在一起。他原本涣散的眼神渐渐恢复了神采，体内枯竭的灵力也开始重新流转。
杨戬被汽化的左臂，竟然也慢慢长出了新的肉芽。虽然无法立刻恢复如初，但至少不再流血，疼痛感也大幅减轻。
后羿腿上的伤口瞬间愈合，他重新站起身，握紧了手中的射日弓。
张二狗和申公豹的内伤也快速好转，两人互相搀扶着，脸上露出了难以置信的神色。
“这……这是枯木逢春？”申公豹声音颤抖地说道，“这不是早就失传的上古禁术吗？据说施展此术，需要燃烧自身的神农血脉和毕生修为，代价极大啊！”
庄周看着神农女的背影，眼底充满了愧疚和心疼。他知道，神农女为了救大家，付出了怎样的代价。
绿色的光芒越来越盛，整个雁门关的废墟之上，竟然长出了无数嫩绿的小草。这些小草在炮火的洗礼中顽强地生长着，象征着生命的希望。
破晓君王看着眼前这一幕，脸色变得无比阴沉。“愚蠢的女人，竟然为了一群废物，燃烧自己的血脉和修为。今天，我就让你们一起去死！”
说完，他猛地一挥手，一道黑色的能量光束朝着神农女射去。
悟空怒吼一声，纵身跃起，金箍棒迎风一晃，挡住了能量光束。
巨大的冲击力让悟空连连后退，但他的眼神却无比坚定。
“神农女，谢谢你！”悟空大声说道，“接下来，就交给我们吧！”
哪吒也冲了上来，火尖枪直指破晓君王：“没错！我们绝不会让你的阴谋得逞！”
杨戬、后羿、张二狗、申公豹也纷纷站了出来，挡在了神农女的身前。
他们的伤势虽然还没有完全恢复，但他们的意志却无比坚定。
神农女用自己的生命为他们争取了机会，他们绝不能辜负这份牺牲。
神农女看着挡在自己身前的众人，脸上露出了欣慰的笑容。她的身体越来越虚弱，绿色的光芒也开始渐渐黯淡。
说完，她眼前一黑，缓缓倒了下去。
庄周连忙冲过去，接住了神农女。他将一股柔和的蝶力注入神农女的体内，稳住了她的气息。
“放心吧，她只是脱力了。”庄周说道，“我们一定会赢的，为了她，也为了所有死去的兄弟。”

Chapter 136 The Shennong Girl’s Forbidden Technique Revives the Dead Tree (Page 1)
The green light was like the warm spring sun, gently covering everyone who was seriously injured and fell to the ground. The Shennong Girl opened her arms, and the spiritual power of the herbs around her surged wildly. The originally weak green light now became dazzling, illuminating the dim battlefield.
Her body was trembling slightly, and every inch of her skin was burning. Shennong's blood boiled in her body, turning into a steady stream of life force and injecting it into everyone's bodies.
The bone-deep blood hole in Wukong's chest was healing at a speed visible to the naked eye. The golden blood stopped flowing, and the broken ribs were put back together. His originally distracted eyes gradually regained their vitality, and the depleted spiritual power in his body began to flow again.
Yang Jian's vaporized left arm actually slowly grew new flesh buds. Although it cannot be restored immediately, at least the bleeding is no longer and the pain is greatly reduced.
The wound on Hou Yi's leg healed instantly. He stood up again and grasped the sun bow in his hand.
The internal injuries of Zhang Ergou and Shen Gongbao also improved quickly. They supported each other with disbelief on their faces.
"This...is this dead tree blooming in spring?" Shen Gongbao said in a trembling voice, "Isn't this an ancient forbidden technique that has been lost for a long time? It is said that to perform this technique, one needs to burn one's own Shennong bloodline and lifelong cultivation, which is extremely costly!"
Zhuang Zhou looked at the back of Shennong Girl, his eyes filled with guilt and distress. He knew what kind of price the Shen Nong girl paid to save everyone.
The green light grew stronger and stronger, and countless green grass grew out of the ruins of Yanmen Pass. These grasses grow tenaciously amidst the baptism of artillery fire, symbolizing the hope of life.
The Dawn King looked at the scene in front of him, and his expression became extremely gloomy. "Stupid woman, she burned her own blood and cultivation for a bunch of trash. Today, I will let you die together!"
After saying that, he waved his hand suddenly, and a black energy beam shot towards the Shennong Girl.
Wukong roared angrily, jumped up, and swung his golden cudgel into the wind, blocking the energy beam.
The huge impact made Wukong retreat repeatedly, but his eyes were extremely determined.
"Shennong Girl, thank you!" Wukong said loudly, "Leave it to us next!"
Nezha also rushed forward, pointing his spear directly at the King of Dawn: "That's right! We will never let your conspiracy succeed!"
Yang Jian, Hou Yi, Zhang Ergou, and Shen Gongbao also stood up and stood in front of the Shennong Girl.
Although their injuries have not fully recovered, their will is extremely determined.
Shen Nong Nu used her own life to fight for a chance for them, and they must not live up to this sacrifice.
The Shen Nong girl looked at the people standing in front of her, with a happy smile on her face. Her body became weaker and weaker, and the green light began to fade.
After saying that, her vision went dark and she slowly fell down.
Zhuang Zhou rushed over and caught the Shennong girl. He injected a gentle butterfly power into the body of the Shennong Girl, stabilizing her aura.
"Don't worry, she just lost her strength." Zhuang Zhou said, "We will definitely win, for her sake and for the sake of all the dead brothers."
